defect: wmma_abba_analyze.py used a 12-entry two-tailed 95% t table and T95.get(df, 1.96); phase_lxv_stats.py extended the table to 32 degrees of freedom and kept the same 1.96 fallback. Both silently replace a finite-sample t quantile with the normal quantile, which makes intervals too narrow.
method: Each pair's statistic is the median of that run's per-iteration samples (unchanged). The interval is the two-sided 95% Student-t interval over the per-pair ratios with df = pairs - 1, using a computed quantile. The point estimate and the geomean are unchanged.

unrecomputable_sweeps.reason: no raw per-iteration ABBA samples are present in this tree; only reported summary numbers survive. Those intervals are therefore not recomputed here and are not used for any new decision. Re-running the sweeps would be required.
